description: Reserve an offer for the user: re-prices the offer, holds availability and creates an order awaiting payment. Ask the user to confirm the offer, travellers and contact details first. When the result is price_changed, show the new price and call accept_price_change only if the user agrees.

phone.description: Phone number without the country prefix.

phonePrefix.description: International dialling prefix, for example +48. Defaults to +48.

currency.description: Charge currency as an ISO 4217 code. Defaults to PLN.

driverLicenseYears.description: Years the main driver has held a driving licence.

endDate.description: End date of the service, YYYY-MM-DD, when the offer does not fix it.

externalId.description: Offer identifier (externalId) returned by a search tool.

idempotencyKey.description: Unique key of 8 to 100 characters that you generate once per attempt. Repeating it never creates a duplicate.

insuranceAddon.description: Optional travel insurance variant added to the booking.

startDate.description: Start date of the service, YYYY-MM-DD, when the offer does not fix it.

travellers.description: People travelling or insured. The first one is the lead traveller and the main driver.

citizenship.description: Citizenship as a two-letter ISO country code.

firstName.description: First name as in the travel document.

gender.description: Gender as in the travel document. Airlines require it for flight bookings.

lastName.description: Last name as in the travel document.

vehiclePlate.description: Vehicle registration number. Required for parking.

name: create_booking
title: Create booking
